result.title: HP-PnP-Flow: Hybrid Time Scheduling and Projection for Plug-and-Play Image Restoration via Flow Matching
result.summary: Image restoration is a fundamental inverse problem that seeks to recover high-quality images from degraded observations. Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods provide a flexible framework for integrating pretrained denoisers into iterative reconstruction, whereas flow matching offers an efficient generative modeling approach based on continuous-time ODE dynamics. Very recently, Martin et al.\ (ICLR, 2025) developed a PnP-Flow method, which integrates the PnP framework with flow matching through a time-dependent denoiser constructed from a pretrained flow matching model.By incorporating a different time schedule and an additional pixel-space projection operator, this paper proposes a novel efficient PnP-Flow algorithm (HP-PnP-Flow) that enjoys rigorous convergence guarantees under mild assumptions, without imposing restrictive conditions on iterates required by the aforementioned work. Numerical experiments on CelebA and AFHQ-Cat demonstrate that the newly proposed HP-PnP-Flow algorithm significantly outperforms PnP-Flow on several restoration tasks such as denoising, deblurring, super-resolution, random inpainting, and box inpainting. Notably, our algorithm achieves comparable or better reconstruction quality with substantially fewer iterations, reducing the iteration count from $500$ to $100$ for deblurring and super-resolution on AFHQ-Cat.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 HP-PnP-Flow，将混合时间调度与像素空间投影算子引入基于 flow matching 的即插即用图像复原框架，并在去噪、去模糊、超分与修补任务上超过 PnP-Flow。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于图像逆问题复原的生成式采样加速工作，虽涉及 ODE 时间调度与迭代投影，但研究对象是像素图像而非 VLM 内部推理状态，也未涉及视觉证据筛选、推理步数决策或答案对 latent 内容的使用，缺乏可供核查的具体借鉴线索。
